name: Automated Crop
project_description:
Provides an API for automatic cropping tools integration.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 2.x and up now supports Drupal 9 and up! 
 Crop module 2.x-dev or higher 
 
 Note on upgrading from 2.x to 3.x: 
 to streamline the functionality we've removed the deprecated automated_crop_crop_provider module in 3.x. Please make sure to uninstall this module before upgrading to 3.x.
